title: useFormStore
subtitle: Sync form data from a store
description: Create a form whose data stays in sync with qortex-store (or duck-typed get/subscribe).

signature.code:
function useFormStore<T, S = T>(config: UseFormStoreConfig<T, S>): ReturnType<typeof useForm<T>>
// from "qortex-form-react/store"

content: On successful `form.save(mutator)`, draft resets via the form. **Store write-back is the caller's concern** — update the store in your mutator or after an external refresh. This binder only reads.

examples.title: Settings from store
